customer: hi so we traded in our minivan and i think my autopay still went thru to the lender after you paid it off?? with a newborn at home money is kinda tight so i really need that back, do i get it from northwind or what
agent: Congratulations on the new baby, and I understand wanting that money back quickly. Per our article "Getting back an extra loan payment," if your lender received both our payoff and your regular payment, the extra amount belongs to you, and your lender refunds it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed. Northwind doesn't receive or forward overpayments, so if the refund doesn't arrive, please contact your lender directly.
